note: PSG rule inventory (plan 05-01, D-07, D-12). One record per rule; basis names how well the page set backs it; vectors lists every vector of data/psg/vectors that names the rule (checked by the psg-vectors step). No profile field of the psg group exists yet: the fields are added by the plan whose generator reads them.

rules.statement: Sixteen registers, each readable and writable at its address.
The register permutation into 01F0..01FF: role per address as in the register-address literal.
rules.note: Single tier 4 lineage; the 8914 delta against the data sheet is known only from that source. resolver: D10 register read-back on owner hardware. trigger: a schematic, a data sheet of the part or a measured read-back.

rules.statement: Write and read masks: stores keep value AND the write mask, reads give the store AND the read mask with bits 15..8 zero.
rules.note: Masks from the community data bits column; the shape register read mask is the tier 4 zero (C75). resolver: D10 read-back. trigger: owner hardware or a part-specific sheet.

rules.statement: A read of any PSG register has no side effect.
rules.note: The page says each register is readable and nothing about side effects. resolver: D10 repeated read-back. trigger: any observed change after a read.

rules.statement: Tone frequency: the input clock divided by 16 and then by the 12-bit period, a square wave at 50 percent duty: half-period P steps (16 P master ticks).
rules.note: The divide chain is printed, the 50 percent duty and the toggle at each half-period are inference; the closed-form equation is not printed on the pages read. resolver: D10 tone capture. trigger: a measured edge spacing.

rules.statement: Tone period field is 12 bits, so the largest period is 4095.
rules.note: The 12-bit width is printed (TP11..TP0); the sentence naming 1 and 4095 as the range limits is not on the pages read. resolver: D10 tone capture at 4095. trigger: a measured edge spacing.

rules.statement: Period 0 acts as the range top: tone 4096 and envelope 65536 (community), noise 32 (default by analogy).
rules.note: Tone and envelope zero from the community statement, noise zero has no source (policy POL-PSG-03). resolver: D10 capture with period 0. trigger: a measured edge spacing at period 0.

rules.statement: Tone counter structure: a down-reload counter, a period write takes effect at the next reload.
rules.note: Steady state equals an up-compare counter; the two differ for a write during a half-cycle. resolver: D10 capture of a mid-cycle period write. trigger: a measured difference.

rules.statement: Noise rate: the input clock divided by 16 and then by the 5-bit period; the register shifts every 2 NP steps.
rules.note: The chain and the 5-bit width are printed; reading the noise frequency as the shift rate is inference. resolver: D10 noise capture. trigger: a measured shift spacing.

rules.statement: Noise register polynomial, seed and output sense: right-shifting Galois, width 17, mask 12000 hex, seed 1, output bit 0.
rules.note: No printed polynomial; the community mask is a one-field edit. resolver: D10 noise capture. trigger: a measured bit pattern.

rules.statement: Envelope rate: the input clock divided by 256 and then by the 16-bit period gives the cycle, one state per 16 EP chip clocks, so one step per 2 EP PSG steps.
rules.note: Chain printed, the figure names the period as the duration of one cycle; the step reading is inference. resolver: D10 envelope capture. trigger: a measured step spacing.

rules.statement: The sixteen envelope shapes of R15 bits B3..B0 (continue, attack, alternate, hold) with sixteen states per cycle.
A write to the shape register restarts the envelope.
rules.note: Not printed on the data sheet pages. resolver: D10 envelope capture with a mid-cycle rewrite. trigger: a measured difference.

rules.statement: Mixer polarity and bit order: R7 bits 0..2 disable tone A..C, bits 3..5 disable noise A..C, 1 = disabled.
Tone and noise combine by AND after the disable bits are applied; a channel with both disabled is a constant 1.
rules.note: The AND form is from the community statement, not printed on the pages read. resolver: D10 capture of a tone with noise enabled. trigger: a measured waveform.

rules.statement: Amplitude: bits 3..0 of the amplitude register are the 4-bit fixed level.
Amplitude select bits 5..4: 0 fixed, 1 envelope shifted right by 2, 2 envelope shifted right by 1, 3 envelope.
rules.note: The mode bit sense is not printed on the pages read. resolver: D10 output level capture per register value. trigger: a measured level.

rules.statement: Step scheduling and write ordering: a write stamped at a step boundary lands after that step (step first, then write).
rules.note: A project contract, not a hardware claim. resolver: test psg.write tie tests, D10 refinement. trigger: a measured write-to-output latency.

rules.statement: DAC levels: sixteen output levels of a logarithmic converter between 0 and 1 volt.
rules.note: The pages print the range only, no per-level label; the table is a default copied from a planning note. resolver: D10 output level capture. trigger: a measured level table.

rules.statement: Port reads: input mode follows the pins with an on-chip pull-up idle of FF, output mode returns the store, a write stores the latch.
rules.note: Pull-up idle and grounding are printed; direction sense and the output-mode read are not. resolver: D10 port probes. trigger: a measured read in output mode.

rules.statement: Reset: all registers 0, both ports input; generator state at its defaults.
rules.note: Registers literal; the generator state beyond the registers is default (policy POL-PSG-12). resolver: D10 power-on capture. trigger: a measured first sample.
